newsitem.title: INDIA: Twenty feared dead in Indian truck accident.
newsitem.headline: Twenty feared dead in Indian truck accident.

text.p: At least 20 people were believed to have died when the truck they were travelling in plunged off a bridge into a crocodile-infested river in western India, the Press Trust of India said on Sunday.
The news agency said the small truck collided with another vehicle on a bridge near Dhaulpur town, 240 km (150 miles) southwest of New Delhi in Rajasthan state.

The truck fell 45 metres (150 feet) into the river, which PTI said was a breeding ground for crocodiles and large tortoises. PTI quoted police as saying there was only one survivor among the two dozen people in the truck.
